critical_code_review_comments: ResultPreview.jsx onSuccess() swallows deep-generation polling errors with empty catch (line 51) - if /api/generate-deep/{id}/status repeatedly 5xxs the user silently stays on the base report after timeout without any error toast. Consider toast.error on persistent failure or a 'Retry' button on the BuildingBlueprint after timeout.

ResultPreview.jsx BuildingBlueprint copy says 'This takes up to a minute' but actual generation took ~110s and the frontend polls up to 3.5 min - consider updating microcopy to '1-3 minutes' to match real backend latency and prevent user abandonment.

ResultPreview.jsx polling interval is fixed at 4s for 52 iterations (~3.5min). Consider exponential backoff or server-sent events to reduce backend load when many concurrent users generate deep reports.

ReportRenderer.jsx (267 lines) is approaching readability limits; section block components (TableBlock, Timeline, BlueprintPhases, Recommendations, etc.) could be split into a sections/blocks/ subfolder for clarity.
